# inkMOD v1.1.10 — Screen Refresh & UI Fixes

This release focuses on improved screen-refresh behavior and navigation responsiveness for **XTEINK X3**, plus fixes across reader controls and screenshot handling.

### X3 — Screen Cleanup
- Added **Eco** (no extra cleanup), **Standard** (2 no-flash passes), **Maximum** (4 no-flash passes), and **With flash**.
- **Refresh Frequency** now appears under Screen Cleanup only when **With flash** is selected.
- The **No-Flash Refresh** manual action applies four passes.
- Settings tab changes no longer run cleanup. Screen Cleanup in the menus is limited to two passes in Maximum mode to reduce delay, while reading keeps the selected mode.
- Fixed an empty/incorrectly highlighted row when changing modes, and corrected Screen Cleanup / Refresh Frequency ordering.

### Reader / display updates
- Updated X3 EPUB/FB2, TXT and XTC grayscale page-rendering paths so No-Flash mode does not inadvertently request a full refresh.
- Removed a redundant explicit grayscale preconditioning pass after a requested full flash on X3.
- Improved screen transitions into settings and reader menus.
- Added a safeguard for FB2 anchor navigation.

### Screenshots
- Updated screenshot feedback to flash while the border is displayed.
- Improved screenshot shortcut availability outside the reader and added fallback feedback under low-memory conditions.

### Builds
Release assets cover **X3/X4**, **X4 Pro**, and **X4 Classic**, with a compatibility filename for older X3/X4 OTA clients. Use firmware matching your device. The X3-specific display modes do not apply to other hardware.

### Known limitations
- Initial hardware synchronization after cold start may still flash on X3; it was deliberately left intact to avoid E-Ink panel state corruption.
- X4 Pro issues [#38](https://github.com/alpzoloto-sudo/inkmod/issues/38) (FB2 links), [#39](https://github.com/alpzoloto-sudo/inkmod/issues/39) (emulator panic), and [#40](https://github.com/alpzoloto-sudo/inkmod/issues/40) (footnote return) have **not** been confirmed fixed and remain open.

**Upgrade carefully:** firmware files are model-specific. Keep a recovery path available.
